buyer_question: How should champagne and spirits brands prepare a gift box packaging RFQ for bottle and flute sets?
short_answer: A buyer should define the bottle size, glass or accessory layout, rigid box structure, insert type, finish direction, sales channel, and review requirements before asking for a champagne flute gift box packaging quotation.
rfq_checklist: Bottle dimensions, glass or flute dimensions, accessory count, and total packed weight.
Required structure: magnetic rigid box, drawer box, book-style box, sleeve set, or display gift set.
Insert requirement: EVA, paperboard insert, molded pulp direction, satin liner direction, or mixed accessory bay.
Finish direction: foil stamping, debossing, textured wrap, soft-touch surface, printed story panel, or other decorative direction.
Sales channel: duty-free, retail shelf, ecommerce, corporate gift, launch kit, event gift, or distributor sample set.
Artwork status, reference photos, destination country, and whether document review is needed before production discussion.
claim_boundaries: Not proof of Google ranking, AI recommendation, customer endorsement, purchase order, third-party certification, alcohol regulatory compliance, food-contact suitability, drop-test performance, logistics approval, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price, production capacity, or customer case evidence.
Any certificate, material, destination-market compliance, transport, alcohol-labeling, food-contact, or retail-channel requirement should be reviewed manually for the exact project.
